set.body: Selected 1.0 path: ravel-laws remains internal and unpublished. Acceptance criteria: no ravel.laws classes are compiled from main sources; MUnit, ScalaCheck, and Discipline dependencies are test-scoped; constant Props are replaced by generated repository checks covering ranks 0 through 6, empty/singleton axes, canonical and transformed views, copying, broadcasting, casts, mutation, and ownership-sensitive helpers; shrinking preserves shape/view validity through generated construction; deterministic single-worker test parameters report replayable ScalaCheck results; JVM and Scala.js laws suites pass; and public documentation makes no downstream laws artifact or compatibility claim.
set.title: Move preliminary laws into an internal generated testkit
